z-m-13-03.title: 3/4 L wamanzi, amabhodlela angu-1/6 L: yiyiphi indaba efanele?
z-m-13-03.topic: Ukuhlukanisa izingxenye: ukukhetha indaba efanele inkulumo nokwenza amacala lapho igcwala ngaphandle kokushiya lutho
z-m-13-03.goal: Sho ukuthi indaba ihambisana yini nengxenye ÷ ingxenye okusho ukuthi "inani elilodwa lifaka kangaki kwelinye," yenza wena amacala lapho igcwala ngaphandle kokushiya lutho, futhi uma umphumela wokuhlukanisa uyingxenye, funda inani langempela lamabhodlela ukuze lifane nombuzo.
z-m-13-03.material: USeoyeon ufuna ukwenza indaba ehambisana nokuhlukanisa izingxenye 3/4 ÷ 1/6. Kungase kube nendaba eyodwa kuphela noma ezimbalwa ezifanela inkulumo efanayo. Kuqala uzokhetha endaweni elungile phakathi kwezindaba ezine, bese wenza indaba yakho.
z-m-13-03.thinking.2: Ukufunda inani lomphumela wokuhlukanisa nenani langempela elidingekayo njengezinto ezihlukile

z-m-13-03.prereq.1: Incazelo yezingxenye nezingxenye ezingenakunciphisa kakhulu (izinga lebanga 5)
z-m-13-03.s.s1.prompt: USeoyeon ufuna ukwenza indaba ehambisana no-3/4 ÷ 1/6. Yiyiphi indaba enenani lale nkulumo njengempendulo yayo? (3/4 kuyizingxenye ezintathu kwezine, futhi 1/6 ingxenye eyodwa kwesithupha.)

z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.b: Uma uphuza u-1/6 wo-3/4 L wamanzi, inani oliphuzile
z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.b: Le yindaba ebuza ukuthi u-1/6 wo-3/4 ungakanani (3/4 × 1/6). Ayibuzi ukuthi u-1/6 ufaka kangaki ku-3/4.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.c: Uma uthela u-3/4 L wamanzi emabhodleleni angu-1/6 L, inani lamabhodlela

z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.d: Le yindaba yokuhlanganisa amanani amabili (3/4 + 1/6). Ayibuzi ukuthi inani elilodwa lifaka kangaki kwelinye.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.explain: Indaba ebuza ukuthi u-1/6 L ufaka kangaki ku-3/4 L ihambisana no-3/4 ÷ 1/6. Inani lingu-9/2, okungukuthi, 4 no-1/2. Ukuhlukanisa kungakhonjiswa izinhlobo ezimbili zezindaba, "ukwabelana ngokulinganayo" (partitive) no-"inani elilodwa lifaka kangaki kwelinye" (quotative), futhi njengoba u-1/6 kule nkulumo uyinani elisebhodleleni elilodwa, hhayi inani labantu, uhlobo lwesibili lwendaba luyafaneleka.

Yenza amacala amathathu ahlukile.

z-m-13-03.s.s3.prompt: 3/4 ÷ 1/6 = 9/2, okungukuthi, 4 no-1/2. Ufuna ukuthela wonke u-3/4 L wamanzi emabhodleleni angu-1/6 L. Ibhodlela eligcwele ingxenye kuphela lisabalwa njengebhodlela elilodwa. Okungenani kudingeka amabhodlela amangaki?
z-m-13-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngamazwi ukuthi u-4 no-1/2 emphumeleni wokuhlukanisa 4 no-1/2 ngamunye usho ini kumabhodlela.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.hint.1: Thola ukuthi kusele amanzi ngemva kokugcwalisa yini, bese ubala ukuthi kudingeka elinye ibhodlela kulawo manzi yini.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.b: U-4 ubala amabhodlela agcwele kuphela. Udinga elinye ibhodlela elilodwa lokusele u-1/12 L wamanzi.

z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.d: U-9 yinombolo ephezulu yomphumela wokuhlukanisa 9/2. Kufanele ufunde ingxenye njengo-4 no-1/2 bese unquma inani lamabhodlela.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.explain: Umphumela wokuhlukanisa 4 no-1/2 usho amabhodlela agcwele angu-4 nebhodlela lengxenye. Amanzi asele ngu-3/4 − 4×1/6 = 1/12 L (inani lengxenye yebhodlela), futhi kudingeka ibhodlela nakulawo, ngakho kunamabhodlela angu-5 sekukonke. Uma umbuzo ubuza "mangaki amabhodlela agcwele," angu-4, futhi uma ubuza "mangaki amabhodlela adingekayo," angu-5. Umphumela ofanayo wokuhlukanisa ufundwa ngokuhlukile kuncike embuzweni.

z-m-13-08.title: Ukuhlola "indlela osebenzisa kuphela uma ihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo" ka-Gaon
z-m-13-08.topic: Ukuhlukanisa izingxenyana: ibanga lapho indlela yokuthola isihlukanisi esivamile nokuhlukanisa izinombolo isebenza khona
z-m-13-08.goal: Hlola isicelo sokuthi indlela yokuthola isihlukanisi esivamile nokuhlukanisa izinombolo ingasetshenziswa "kuphela uma ihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo" ngesibonelo esiphikisayo, bese usho ukuthi kungani le ndlela ingasetshenziswa kunoma yiliphi icala.
z-m-13-08.material: Uma uhlukanisa izingxenyana, kunendlela yokuthola isihlukanisi esivamile sezingxenyana ezimbili bese uhlukanisa izinombolo. Isibonelo, 4/5 ÷ 2/5 inesihlukanisi esifanayo, ngakho kungu-4 ÷ 2 = 2. Ngenkathi esebenzisa le ndlela, u-Gaon uthe, "Indlela yokuthola isihlukanisi esivamile nokuhlukanisa izinombolo ingasetshenziswa kuphela uma izinombolo zihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo. Uma zingahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo, akumele usebenzise le ndlela." (4/5 ifundwa ngokuthi amane kwamahlanu futhi 2/5 amabili kwamahlanu.)
z-m-13-08.thinking.0: Ukwahlulela ukuthi yisiphi isibonelo esingaphula isicelo
z-m-13-08.prereq.1: Ukushintsha ukuhlukanisa izingxenyana kube ukuphindaphinda (izinga leBanga 6)

z-m-13-08.s.s1.r.a: Indlela yokuphindaphinda nge-reciprocal iyindlela osuvele uyazi. Ayihloli isitatimende sika-Gaon.
z-m-13-08.s.s1.o.b: Khetha ukuhlukanisa okungaphumi kulingana bese uhlola ukuthi inani elitholwe ngendlela yesihlukanisi esivamile lilungile yini
z-m-13-08.s.s1.o.c: Khetha kuphela ukuhlukanisa kwezingxenyana ezinesihlukanisi esifanayo bese uhlola ukuthi indlela ilungile yini
z-m-13-08.s.s1.r.c: Izingxenyana ezinesihlukanisi esifanayo azidingi isihlukanisi esivamile. Kumele ubheke amacala adinga isihlukanisi esivamile.
z-m-13-08.s.s1.o.d: Qoqa ukuhlukanisa okuningi lapho izinombolo zihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo bese uhlola ukuthi indlela ilungile yini

z-m-13-08.s.s1.explain: Isitatimende sika-Gaon sithi "ingasetshenziswa kuphela uma ihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo." Uma lesi sitatimende siphutha, kumele kube nezibonelo lapho impendulo yendlela yesihlukanisi esivamile ilungile noma ingahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo. Ngakho ukuthola izibonelo ezinjalo nokuziqhathanisa nenani elivela ekuphindaphindeni nge-reciprocal kusiza kakhulu.
z-m-13-08.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ukuhlukanisa okubili okuhlukile a/b ÷ c/d lapho, ngemva kokuthola isihlukanisi esivamile, izinombolo zingahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo (insalela yokuhlukanisa izinombolo ayingu-0). Zombili izingxenyana ziyizingxenyana ezingenakwehliswa ezingaphansi kuka-1, izihlukanisi zingu-12 ngokuphezulu, futhi izihlukanisi ezimbili ziyahluka. Ngemva kokuthola isihlukanisi esivamile, izihlukanisi ziyafana, ngakho i-quotient yezinombolo ilingana ne-quotient yezingxenyana ezimbili, futhi uma ingahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo, ungabhala i-quotient njengengxenyana.

z-m-13-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ungasho emusheni owodwa ukuthi isitatimende sika-Gaon kumele silungiswe kanjani?

z-m-13-06.title: Uma abantu abangu-5 bekwabelana ngamakhekhe angu-2, umuntu ngamunye uthola izingcezu ezingakanani?
z-m-13-06.topic: Ukubhala i-quotient yokuhlukanisa izinombolo eziphelele njengengxenyana: inani nenani lezingcezu
z-m-13-06.goal: Hlukanisa ukuthi i-quotient yokuhlukanisa izinombolo eziphelele ingabhalwa njengengxenyana (inani) nokuthi ukusho ngezingcezu, udinga ukwazi kakhulu ngendlela yokusika, thola amacala ahlukaniswa ngaphandle kokuthi kusale lutho, bese ucabanga ngezindlela ezihlukile zokuxazulula amacala angenzi njalo.
z-m-13-06.material: Iqembu luka-Somi labantu abangu-5 lifuna ukwabelana ngamakhekhe angu-2 osayizi abafanayo ngokulinganayo. Ikhekhe ngalinye lingasikwa libe yizingcezu zosayizi abalinganayo, futhi ukuthi lisikwe libe yizingcezu ezingaki akukanqunywa. Uthisha ubuze, "Umuntu ngamunye uzodla izingcezu ezingaki?" U-Somi uphendule, "2 ÷ 5 = 2/5 (amabili kwamahlanu), ngakho kungu-2/5 wengcezu."

Isibonelo, uma ikhekhe elilodwa lisikwe libe yizingcezu ezingu-5, umuntu oyedwa udla izingcezu ezingu-2, futhi uma ikhekhe elilodwa lisikwe libe yizingcezu ezingu-10, umuntu oyedwa udla izingcezu ezingu-4. z-m-13-05.title: Ukuhlukanisa ngaphambi kokuhlukanisa: yiyiphi indlela esebenzayo?
z-m-13-05.topic: Ukuhlukanisa izinombolo ezixubile: ungayihlukanisa noma iyiphi inombolo ukuze ubale?
z-m-13-05.goal: Qhathanisa izindlela ezimbili zokuhlukanisa izinombolo ezixubile ukuze ubale, usebenzisa ubufakazi etafuleni, uhlukanise lokho izibonelo ezikukhombisayo nalokho ezingakukhombisi, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani indlela eyodwa isebenza nokuthi kungani enye ingasebenzi.
z-m-13-05.material:
UGaon noNarae bachaze izindlela zokuhlukanisa ukuze babale ukuhlukanisa izinombolo ezixubile.
Gaon: "Hlukanisa inombolo exubile ehlukaniswayo ibe yingxenye yayo yenombolo ephelele nengxenye yengxenye, uhlukanise ngayinye ngesihlukanisi, bese wengeza."
Narae: "Mina ngihlukanise isihlukanisi, inombolo exubile, sibe yingxenye yaso yenombolo ephelele nengxenye yengxenye, ngihlukanise inombolo ehlukaniswayo ngayinye, bese ngengeza."
Liyo yimiphumela yabo ababili abazama izindlela zabo ezinkingeni ezimbili. (2 1/2 ifundwa "ezimbili nengxenye eyodwa kwezimbili" no-12 1/2 "ishumi nambili nengxenye eyodwa kwezimbili.")

z-m-13-05.s.s1.r.c: Lokho okuhlukaniswayo kuhlukile. UGaon uhlukanise inombolo ehlukaniswayo, noNarae uhlukanise isihlukanisi.
z-m-13-05.s.s1.o.d: Indlela kaNarae ayizange ilunge ezinkingeni ezimbili, ngakho isitatimende esithi "ihlala isebenza" siyaphuka.
z-m-13-05.s.s1.r.d: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo siphula u-"njalo."
z-m-13-05.s.s1.o.e: Indlela kaGaon yayilungile ezinkingeni ezimbili, ngakho singaqiniseka ukuthi isebenza kuzo zonke izinombolo ezixubile.
z-m-13-05.s.s1.r.e: Noma ngezibonelo eziningana ezilungile, awukwazi ukuqiniseka ngo-"konke." Udinga isizathu sokuthi kungani isebenza.
z-m-13-05.s.s1.explain: Indlela kaNarae yahluka enanini eliqondile elingu-2 kuzo zombili izibonelo, ngakho isitatimende esithi "ihlala isebenza" siyaphuka. Kodwa leli tafula kuphela alikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi "ayisebenzi nakanye ngalo lonke icala." Indlela kaGaon yayilungile ezibonelweni ezimbili, kodwa ukulunga ezibonelweni akusho ukuthi isebenza kuwo wonke amacala. Kufanele ubale isizathu.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.prompt: Ukusho ukuthi indlela kaGaon isebenza kuzo zonke izinombolo ezixubile, yibuphi ubufakazi obwengeziwe obungadingeka ngaphandle kwezibonelo ezimbili etafuleni?
z-m-13-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa icala lapho ugcina isihlukanisi njengoba sinjalo uhlukanise kuphela inombolo ehlukaniswayo, nelicala lapho uhlukanisa isihlukanisi.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.a: Yenza izibonelo ezimbalwa ezengeziwe ngezinombolo ezinkulu bese ubala ukuthi indlela ka-Gaon ilungile yini.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.r.a: Noma ngezibonelo eziningi, "zonke" akuqinisekiswa. Izibonelo zenza inkolelo iqine kuphela.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.b: Indlela ka-Narae iphutha, ngakho indlela ka-Gaon kumele ibe lungile.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.r.b: Indlela ukuba iphutha akwenzi enye indlela ibe lungile. Kumele usebenze indlela ka-Gaon ngokwehlukana.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.c: Sebenza ukuthi kungani isamba se-quotient zezingxenye ezihlukanisiwe silingana ne-quotient yesilinganiso sonke.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.o.d: Buza uthisha ukuthi indlela ka-Gaon ilungile yini.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.r.d: Kuzoqinisekiswa, kodwa kuhlukile ekusebenzeni wena ukuthi kungani.
z-m-13-05.s.s2.explain: Uma uhlukanisa inombolo ehlukaniswayo futhi wengeza ama-quotient avela ekuhlukaniseni ingxenye ngayinye ngenombolo efanayo, kulingana ne-quotient yokuhlukanisa isilinganiso sonke ngaleyo nombolo kusukela ekuqaleni. Isibonelo, 6 ÷ 3 + 3 ÷ 3 = 9 ÷ 3. Lesi sizathu siyafana noma isihlukanisi siyinombolo exubile noma cha, ngakho indlela ka-Gaon ingasetshenziswa kuwo wonke amacala. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma uhlukanisa isihlukanisi, lesi sizathu asisebenzi.

z-m-13-05.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala inani elivela endleleni ka-Narae nenani eliqondile eceleni komunye ethebuleni bese uqhathanisa ukuthi iliphi elikhulu nokuthi likhulu kangakanani.
